message.icu.bandage_failed: The bandage is useless - there is no blood left to stop
jei.icu.overview.note: A sword or axe wound starts the bleeding; hold a bandage for 3 seconds to stop it
jei.icu.bandage.info.1: Bandage: hold right click for 3 seconds to stop a haemorrhage
jei.icu.bandage.info.2: Blood volume still drops 5%% per second while treating, so waiting too long kills you
jei.icu.bandage.info.3: Afterwards a 5 minute recovery starts: 15 seconds of sprinting or a 4th jump tears the wound open again
